Guess appoints Tamannaah Bhatia as brand ambassador
stories.summary: Guess has named actor Tamannaah Bhatia as its new brand ambassador for watches in India. The company says the partnership marks a bold new moment for the category and a distinctive authority in fashion watches. Tamannaah will reflect the brand DNA through her style and confidence.

stories.title: Gap launches anamorphic digital out-of-home campaign
stories.summary: Gap has launched its first anamorphic digital out-of-home campaign at retail hubs including Phoenix Palladium and DLF Mall of India. The campaign uses large format screens to present three-dimensional visual stories. It aims to seamlessly merge creativity and technology for shoppers in major malls.

stories.title: Candere adds Smriti Mandhana as brand ambassador
stories.summary: Candere has appointed cricketer Smriti Mandhana as a brand ambassador to join Shah Rukh Khan. The lifestyle jewellery brand says the move is a significant step to strengthen its connection with young, modern Indian consumers. The company continues to focus on its omnichannel retail expansion.

stories.title: SBI releases Diwali campaign for workers away from home
stories.summary: State Bank of India has released a festive film titled Ghar Se Dur, Ghar Wali Diwali. The campaign focuses on individuals who cannot return home for the festival due to work commitments. It emphasizes human connection and the spirit of togetherness for those working during the holidays.

stories.title: SBI highlights essential workers in Diwali film
stories.summary: State Bank of India has introduced a campaign titled Ghar Se Dur, Ghar Wali Diwali. The film showcases individuals unable to return home for the festival due to work. It emphasizes relationships over conventional festive themes and acknowledges the contributions of workers who support others during the holidays.

stories.title: Campa Cola launches festive preparation campaign
stories.summary: Campa Cola has introduced a campaign titled Tayyari Big, Tyohaar Bada Big. The brand says it focuses on the preparations behind Indian festivals like cleaning and cooking. It positions the drink as a refreshment amid the hustle of festive activities across various media platforms.

stories.title: The Partnership Agency wins Novo Nordisk mandate
stories.summary: Novo Nordisk has awarded its media and advertising mandate to The Partnership Agency following a competitive pitch. CEO Sandeep Madan stated the win reflects the trust earned by the team and a shared belief in meaningful impact. The agency operates under the Publicis network.

stories.title: WPP to pilot Meta creative tools
stories.summary: WPP will become the first advertising partner to pilot a new creative solution from Meta. The tool is designed to navigate creative strategy and optimization. WPP previously announced a deal with Google for its Open platform as it continues to integrate agentic tools into its service offerings.

stories.title: The Partnership Agency bags media and advertising mandate for Novo Nordisk - IMPACT Magazine
The Partnership Agency secures Novo Nordisk account
stories.summary: The Partnership Agency has been awarded the media and advertising mandate for pharmaceutical company Novo Nordisk. The agency was selected following a pitch process. CEO Sandeep Madan noted that the win reflects the strength of the team and a belief that meaningful impact requires audacity.

stories.title: Brands increasingly bypass agency pitches
stories.summary: A growing number of Indian brands are appointing agencies directly instead of holding traditional multi-agency pitches. WPP CEO Cindy Rose recently criticized the practice as a CEO handshake thing. Publicis Groupe has responded with an open letter defending the trend of direct appointments.

stories.title: Madras HC dismisses PIL against Vimal Elaichi ads
stories.summary: The Madras High Court dismissed a petition against P.B. Agro LLP, ruling that allegations of surrogate advertising require concrete evidence rather than suspicion or media reports. The court held that brand extensions cannot be challenged without proof. Suspicion, it seems, remains insufficient for legal action.

stories.title: Omnicom Media wins Lufthansa Group global mandate
stories.summary: Omnicom Media will manage global media for Lufthansa Group under a five-year mandate beginning January 2027. The deal consolidates brand and performance activities for the airline group, including SWISS and Austrian Airlines, across three continents. Approximately 10,000 active campaigns will move under the agency’s management.

stories.title: Small businesses push back against influencer demands
stories.summary: Small business owners are increasingly documenting influencer requests for free goods and services. One cafe owner shared her experience after a local influencer posted a review following an uncompensated visit. The trend highlights growing friction between creators seeking perks and business owners managing their bottom lines.

stories.title: Influencer environmental campaigns raise $40 million
stories.summary: YouTubers MrBeast and Mark Rober led the #TeamWater campaign, which raised $40 million by August 2025 to provide clean water to communities in countries including Nigeria and Rwanda. Google and YouTube contributed $2 million to the effort. Influencers are now a primary vehicle for large-scale charitable fundraising.

stories.title: TikTok Shop and UGC roles dominate marketing hiring
stories.summary: Roles tied to TikTok Shop and user-generated content have more than doubled their share of marketing hiring since 2023, according to Net Influencer. While generalist social media titles lose ground, creative strategist roles have also seen significant growth. The job market is prioritising specific platform-native skills.

stories.title: Influencer talent management commissions face pressure
stories.summary: Established creators are increasingly negotiating agency commissions down from the standard 20 percent to 15 percent. As creators gain the ability to attract advertisers independently, the value proposition of traditional talent management agencies is being questioned. Agencies are now competing for talent that no longer needs them.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh plans entertainment hub in Vizag
stories.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government is exploring plans to establish Visakhapatnam as a hub for film, gaming, and digital content creation. IT Minister Nara Lokesh and producer Rana Daggubati discussed the proposal, which aims to move beyond traditional production incentives to build an integrated ecosystem for the creator economy.

stories.title: Creators move from YouTube to cinema screens
stories.summary: Amelia Dimoldenberg is screening the final episodes of her long-running YouTube series, Chicken Shop Date, in cinemas. The show, which launched in 2014 after being rejected by traditional broadcasters, is now transitioning from digital platforms to theatrical releases. The rulebook is being rewritten by the creators themselves.

stories.title: Influencer reveals reality behind sponsored parties
stories.summary: Apoorva Mukhija stated that influencer parties are often driven by brand deliverables rather than leisure. She described the effort required to capture multiple camera angles and repeated shots for social media content. The glamorous lifestyle presented online often involves significant work behind the scenes.

stories.title: Communicators urged to adopt creator mindset
stories.summary: Shira Lazar told attendees at Ragan’s Future of Communications Conference that professionals should adopt creator skills to reach modern audiences. While communicators may lack the persona of typical influencers, Lazar argued that the competencies required to engage viewers are identical. Everyone is a creator, whether they know it.

stories.title: Brands shift to standing creator councils
stories.summary: Brands are moving away from one-off influencer campaigns in favor of creator councils. This model involves building standing panels of influencers to foster lasting influence rather than disconnected partnerships. The creator economy is maturing, and brands are looking for consistency over individual, short-term reach.

stories.title: Regional creators experiment with AI dubbing
stories.summary: Instagram and YouTube have introduced AI-powered dubbing tools for regional creators to reach new language markets. The expansion aims to increase viewership, though questions remain regarding whether dubbed content can retain cultural nuance. The technology is ready, but the audience response remains to be seen.

stories.title: Micro-dramas attract brands, but campaign mindset persists - Buzzincontent
Agencies pivot to always-on creator programs
stories.summary: Social and influencer agencies are moving away from campaign-based models to build always-on programs for beauty brands. These agencies aim to translate creator influence into measurable sales and long-term consumer connections. Discovery and purchase decisions are increasingly occurring within the creator economy.

stories.title: YouTube Studio updates analytics and assistant tools
stories.summary: YouTube has replaced its Analytics section with a plain-language Insights layer and introduced a Research tab to replace Trends. Additionally, the Ask Studio assistant can now process up to 10 images at once. The platform is attempting to make data more accessible for creators on desktop and mobile.

stories.title: Google introduces shared codes for creator partnerships
stories.summary: Google will allow YouTube creators to generate unique codes for advertisers to link videos directly to their accounts. The process removes the need for manual channel searches or approval rounds. The announcement provides no launch date, leaving the mechanics of the system to a help page.

stories.title: TikTok launches ad-free subscription in the UK
stories.summary: TikTok users in the UK can now pay £3.99 per month for an ad-free experience. The option is being rolled out to users over 18, who can continue using the free, ad-supported version if they prefer. Users may now see prompts to select their preferred plan in settings.

stories.title: #paid receives TikTok Premier Creative Partner badge
stories.summary: The creator infrastructure firm #paid has been named a TikTok Premier Creative Partner. This designation recognizes the agency for its strategy and campaign performance on the platform. The badge is intended to signal to advertisers that the firm is trusted to manage TikTok-first marketing efforts.

stories.title: Twitch adds short-form video feature
stories.summary: Twitch will allow creators to upload short-form videos made outside the platform starting early next year. The move aims to improve on-platform discovery and increase ad inventory. Twitch executives say the goal is not to turn the site into a TikTok-like destination. Discovery remains a work in progress.

stories.title: Another arrest in Montreal crypto killing
stories.summary: Guillaume Nobert, 38, was arrested in Cancun, Mexico, in connection with the abduction and killing of cryptocurrency influencer Kevin Mirshahi. Nobert is accused of murder and kidnapping. Extradition proceedings to bring him to Quebec are underway. The victim was kidnapped from a luxury condo in July.

stories.title: Twitch debuts shoppable and skippable ads
stories.summary: Twitch has introduced two new ad products designed to support full-funnel marketing needs. The launch coincides with the platform's recent industry gathering, where the service highlighted its ongoing efforts to balance creator interests with the demands of advertisers. The platform continues to navigate its current growing pains.

stories.title: Swipekit’s 2026 Meta Ad Creative Benchmarks gathers data from 13,995 Meta ads - GlobeNewswire
IAS expands TikTok ad measurement
stories.summary: Integral Ad Science has extended its Total Media Quality measurement suite to include CapCut, Lemon8, and additional TikTok advertising formats. The expansion covers placements like TopView and TikTok Shop campaigns. The company cites TikTok's global community of over 1 billion users as the primary driver for the update.

stories.title: YouTube announces GTA VI activations
stories.summary: YouTube will host a 24-hour global gaming livestream to coincide with the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. The platform plans to offer limited-edition digital gifts for viewers during the event. The game is scheduled for release on November 19.

stories.title: Marketing student manages TITANIAM social media
stories.summary: Lyla Cabrera, a transfer student at Cal State Fullerton, now oversees social media for TITANIAM, the department's professional development program. She originally discovered the program through a social media post. She now uses those same platforms to introduce other students to the department's events and career resources.

stories.title: GTA VI videos hit 40 billion views
stories.summary: YouTube reports that videos related to Grand Theft Auto VI have surpassed 40 billion views ahead of the game's November 19 launch. The platform is partnering with Rockstar Games on creator content and interactive features. Viewers can send free digital gifts during the launch week livestream.

stories.title: Nectar launches AI for influencer outreach
stories.summary: Nectar has released Creator Agent, an AI system designed to automate influencer discovery, outreach, and campaign reporting. The product aims to replace manual spreadsheets and direct messages with automated workflows. The company notes that human oversight remains essential for maintaining trust and ensuring a return on investment.

stories.title: Top MarTech News From the Week of November 13th: Updates from Sprout Social, Adobe, TrueDialog, and More - Solutions Rev
Nectar automates influencer marketing
stories.summary: Nectar has launched Creator Agent to manage influencer partnerships from initial discovery to campaign tracking. The tool is intended to reduce time spent on manual tasks like reviewing content and negotiating collaborations. Founders Misbah and Farah Uraizee developed the system to replace traditional spreadsheet-based management processes.

stories.title: Basis expands AI automation tools
stories.summary: Basis has released a unified intelligence and governance layer powered by its Compass AI. The update integrates historical performance data and market research to help media teams move from strategy to execution. The company describes the platform as an intelligent operating system for autonomous advertising.

stories.title: Constant Contact introduces Catalyst AI
stories.summary: Constant Contact has launched Catalyst, an AI marketing solution designed to plan and execute campaigns for small businesses. The company claims the tool provides expert-level work while allowing owners to remain in control. It is intended to assist users who lack the time or resources for consistent marketing.

stories.title: Scrunch launches citation optimization
stories.summary: Scrunch has introduced a capability to help brands identify which third-party sources influence AI-generated recommendations. The tool allows marketers to track citations and develop outreach strategies to strengthen their presence in AI answers. The launch was announced at the Sitecore Symposium.

stories.title: Nectar launches always-on creator agent
stories.summary: Nectar has launched an AI-powered agent designed to put creator programs on autopilot. The tool finds and vets influencers, manages interactions, and tracks performance metrics. The company claims it replaces weeks of manual scrolling and spreadsheet management with an automated system that knows a brand's customers.

stories.title: Cision introduces AI-powered intelligence
stories.summary: Cision has launched Cision Intelligence, a platform combining specialist AI with the company's existing data and media expertise. The service aims to help brands identify market changes and act with confidence through a conversational interface. Initial capabilities are available via the Cision MCP platform.

stories.title: Iterable launches hosted MCP server
stories.summary: Iterable has introduced a hosted MCP server and AI-assisted SDKs to scale marketing AI workflows across teams. The update aims to move AI usage beyond individual advantages to broader organizational application. The company says these tools help integrate customer context across the marketing stack.

stories.title: Marketers deploying AI agents faster than they can measure them - MarTech
Innovid receives top ranking in QKS Group adtech report
stories.summary: Innovid has been named the Most Valuable Pioneer and an Orchestrated AI Leader in the 2026 QKS Group AI Maturity Matrix. The report evaluates providers on their ability to connect creative intelligence, audience signals, and campaign execution. The company is now officially a pioneer of orchestration.

stories.title: The persistent gap between data and business decisions
stories.summary: Enterprises often possess significant amounts of data regarding site visits and marketing spend but struggle to determine actionable steps for the following week. Despite a decade of investment in analytics platforms and marketing clouds, many companies still rely on reports that arrive too late to inform strategy.
